source.note: class.md Empty description blocks before a separator: the block keeps `direction` and `LR` from forming a direction line, so `direction` is a member statement without a label, the block is a description block statement after it, and `LR` on the next line is another member statement; no class, and the direction stays TB, as in mermaid.js, which reads `direction` and `LR` as words. Without the block, `direction`, a line break, and `LR` is a direction line (class/lex-direction-line-value-next-line).
